notes: Tile lighting effects drawn by every map view (src/maps/tileArt.js). Presentation only.

glows: tile id -> light colour (a coloured light pool round the tile, plus soft contact shadows on floors next to blocks); activeGlows: tile id -> light colour while the tile is active (a live hazard).

animations: tile id -> light-only overlay images drawn over the tile and animated: pulse (slow breathing glow), blink (status lights switching on and off), flicker (an unsteady screen). Each tile on a map is offset in time so machines don't flash together. Overrides the tile's own lights (tiles.json).

wallVariants: wall id -> { share, variants: [{ id, image, lights }] }. In the tall-wall views (exploration, Combat Type 1, the map editor) about share of that wall's tiles are drawn as one of the variants instead, chosen from the tile's position. Never on a panel half with a window. Empty by designer decision (Oct 2026): the bulkhead's random Star Trek wall fittings made placed walls look random, so fittings are placed by hand (lcarsWall etc.).
Tile art lives in public/art/sprites/environment/<palette group id>/ (tiles.json paletteGroups), drawn at 4x resolution (256 x 384; the views scale every tile image to the 64 x 96 slot).
